nav.insight.tip: Radar: Lira reads your niche's sources and spots trends and what matters
insight.title: Radar
insight.sub: What matters in your niche today: signals, trends and conclusions
insight.ask.ph: For example: what mattered this week?
insight.refresh.started: Crawling sources — new items in a minute
insight.empty.title: Radar is empty for now
insight.empty.text: Give Lira the sources of your field — sites, feeds, YouTube, Telegram channels. She will read them on her own, analyse every item and bring you what matters each morning.
insight.field.title: Signal field
insight.brief.none.t: It appears in the morning once at least three items have been analysed in the last day.
insight.brief.making: Writing the brief — under a minute
insight.trends.none: No trends yet: Radar needs a few days of reading.
insight.trends.how: Last 24 hours compared with the previous week's daily norm
insight.src.add.t: Paste many links at once: one per line or separated by spaces. The type is detected automatically.
insight.src.del.ask: Delete source “{name}”? Analysed items will stay.
insight.src.noadd: No new sources — these are already listed
insight.src.crawled: Read — new items will be analysed in the next cycle
insight.one.t: An article, video or post: Lira reads it now and stores it in Radar's memory.
insight.one.bad: Paste the full address — it starts with https://
insight.mind.mission.t: You set the mission — your niche in words; Radar never changes it
insight.mind.mission.ask: Your niche in words — e.g. “residential real estate in Minsk” or “PHP web development, security”
insight.mind.evolve.t: usually at night, once a day
insight.mind.evolving: The mind is thinking over what it read — about a minute
insight.mind.theses.none: Theses appear after the first nightly evolution: Radar only states them backed by what it has read.
insight.mind.hyps.none: Radar makes checkable forecasts and later checks them against new items.
insight.mind.watch.none: Mark items with ☆ in the Feed to watch them.
insight.mind.diary.none: The story starts with the first evolution.
insight.gal.title: Galaxy — map of topics
insight.gal.none: The galaxy appears once a few items have been analysed.
insight.gal.help: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, click a star to open the item
insight.ctl.waiting: Radar is waiting for the next cycle
insight.ctl.why: By day Radar spares your computer and talers: few analyses, long items wait for the night. At night it runs at full power.
insight.mode.always.t: Gentle by day (few analyses, long items wait), full power at night
insight.mode.night.t: Silent by day except the morning brief. All work happens in the night window
insight.mode.pause.t: All background work stops. Questions to the analyst and single-link analysis still work
insight.ctl.daylong: Analyse long items by day too (videos, longreads)
insight.ctl.cost: Each analysis is a short request to your Brain model: Dewiar cloud spends talers, your own model is free.
insight.home.open: Open it for the day's key points
insight.ask.title: Ask Lira about your field
insight.ask.hint: Answers come from what Radar has read, with links to the items.
insight.ask.s3: What should I act on first?
tool.scan_code.opened: Scanner is open. Say briefly: “Point the camera at the code.” The code is handled automatically: for a receipt I will offer a button to record the expense. Promise nothing and do not add anything to Money yourself — only the receipt or the person knows the amount.
scan.ereceipt.nosum: This is an electronic receipt, but I couldn't read the amount on its page. Open the receipt and tell me the amount — for example: “record an expense of 23.50”.
scan.ereceipt.nosum_say: I couldn't read the amount on the receipt page — tell me the amount and I'll record it.
scan.note.ereceipt_nosum: An electronic receipt was scanned ({url}); its amount couldn't be read from the page. Record nothing until the person tells you the amount.
scan.note.receipt: Receipt for {amt} — {when}. I offered a button to record the expense — not recorded yet.
scan.note.receipt_have: Receipt for {amt} — {when}. It's already in Money.
scan.note.link: The scanned code contains a link: {url}. I don't know what's there until the person opens it or asks me to read it.
insight.src.empty.t: The page opened but has no posts. Use a feed, a channel or a site section with articles — check the link.
insight.src.empty.tg: The channel is private or has no public preview. Radar reads public channels — ones that open at t.me/s/name without signing in.
insight.src.why.tg_web: This is a Telegram Web link: a channel can't be read by its number. Use the channel's public link — t.me/name or @name (it's in the channel info).
insight.src.found: Found {n}, {m} new — they'll be analysed on the next pass
tool.search.tail: (These are page snippets. If the full text is needed — a poem, an article, instructions — open the link: read_webpage.)
tool.note.read: You are asked to read an existing work (a poem, a fable, a fairy tale). Don't compose or paraphrase anything — the author's exact text is needed. If you remember it word for word to the last line, read it in full; if you're unsure of even one line, search (web_search), open the page with the text (read_webpage) and read it in full, word for word, to the end, starting with the title and author. A search snippet is not the text. Don't stop halfway and don't ask "shall I continue?".
insight.read.q: Break down «{title}»: what's the key point and what does it mean for my field?
insight.read.part: This is the beginning — the full page didn't open. Read it all with «Open original».
insight.read.notext: No text, just a link. Open the original.
help.insight.title: Radar — Lira keeps an eye on your field
help.insight.what: Give Lira the sources of your niche — websites, RSS feeds, YouTube, Telegram channels, Reddit, GitHub. She reads them herself, analyses every piece (an importance signal from 0 to 10), spots rising topics, puts together a daily brief in the morning and sends the most important things right away.
help.insight.how1: «Sources» — paste links in bulk, the type is detected automatically. For Telegram use the channel's public link: t.me/name or @name.
help.insight.how2: «Pulse» — the daily brief, the signal field (the higher the dot, the more important) and trends. Click a dot to open the piece itself.
help.insight.how3: Click any piece to open the reader on the right: Lira's take, why it matters, the full article text and «Open original».
help.insight.how4: «Ask Lira about your field» on «Pulse» — an answer based on what Radar has read, with links to the pieces.
help.insight.how5: «Trends» and «Galaxy» — which topics are growing and how they connect; «Mind» — Radar's mission, conclusions and hypotheses with an accuracy check.
help.insight.how6: «Control» — when to analyse (gently by day, at full power at night), how many analyses per day and from what importance to send urgent news.
help.insight.try1: What's new in my field? → an answer based on what Radar has read, with links
help.insight.try2: What's the main thing on Radar today? → the daily brief
help.insight.tip1: Write a mission in «Mind» in one sentence — what matters to you: analysis gets sharper.
help.insight.tip2: A source shows «nothing found» — check the link: it should be a feed, a channel or a site section with articles.
help.insight.tip3: Analyses use the model: few by day, long pieces (videos, longreads) wait for the night.

phone.blog.fix.ph: E.g. shorter; add delivery; here's how we do it: …

phone.blog.fix.sys: You are editing a blog article for the owner's website at their request. Do exactly what they ask and keep the rest as is. Don't invent facts about the business; keep the markup (## subheadings, «- » lists). If the owner shares their own experience, weave it in using their words. Reply with JSON only: {"title": "…", "descr": "…", "body": "…"}

sites.blog.vf.p: Confirm the site is yours — Yandex Webmaster and Google Search Console will show which searches find you, and new pages get indexed faster.

sites.blog.vf.s3: Choose the «Meta tag» method and copy the whole tag — paste it below.
